# DAX function support

> **Applies to:** Analysts · Developers

This reference lists which DAX functions Lumen's DAX engine implements. Use it to check whether a measure written for Power BI Desktop evaluates in Lumen, and where results can differ.

> [!NOTE]
> This page and its category pages are generated from the engine's function registry by `scripts/docs/gen-dax-function-support.gen.ts`. The comparison list is the table of contents of Microsoft's DAX function reference (<https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dax/toc.json>), retrieved on 2026-11-18; a function Microsoft added after that date is missing from these tables. To refresh both, run `node scripts/docs/gen-dax-m-fetch-microsoft-lists.mjs`, then `npx vitest run --config scripts/docs/gen-dax-m-connector.vitest.config.ts gen-dax`.

## How to read the status

- **Implemented**: the engine evaluates the function. Where a difference from Power BI is known, the Notes column says so.
- **Partial**: the function evaluates, but part of its documented behaviour is missing or different. The Notes column says what.
- **Not implemented**: a formula that calls the function fails with *The function 'NAME' is not supported by this engine (unknown DAX function).* A visual that uses such a measure shows an error instead of a value.

"Implemented" means the function is in the engine's registry; it is not a guarantee that every argument combination matches Power BI. See [Known differences from the Power BI engine](../dax/known-differences-from-the-power-bi-engine.md) for behaviour that differs across functions, such as numeric types and locale.

## Functions not in Microsoft's list

The engine also accepts 25 functions that the comparison list does not contain:

- **Visual calculation**: functions Microsoft documents with visual calculations rather than in the DAX function list. They work only inside a visual calculation.
- **Power BI internal**: functions that Power BI writes into its own generated queries; Lumen accepts them so that copied queries run.
- **Lumen extension**: Excel-style functions the engine accepts but Microsoft's DAX reference does not document. Do not use them in a model you also open in Power BI Desktop: it is not expected to accept them.

| Function | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| ATAN2 | Lumen extension |  |
| CHAR | Lumen extension |  |
| CLEAN | Lumen extension |  |
| CODE | Lumen extension |  |
| COLLAPSE | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| COLLAPSEALL | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| CONCAT | Lumen extension |  |
| DATEFROMPARTS | Lumen extension |  |
| DISTINCTCOUNTX | Lumen extension |  |
| EXPAND | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| EXPANDALL | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| FIRST | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| ISATLEVEL | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| KMEANSCLUSTERING | Lumen extension | Recognised, but always raises an error: Power BI computes clusters with its own algorithm. |
| LAST | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| LTRIM | Lumen extension |  |
| NEXT | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| PREVIOUS | Visual calculation | Visual calculations only. |
| RTRIM | Lumen extension |  |
| STDEV | Lumen extension | Excel-style name; same as STDEV.S. |
| STDEVA | Lumen extension | Excel-style name; same as STDEV.S. |
| TOPNSKIP | Power BI internal | Internal function that Power BI writes into generated visual queries. |
| VAR | Lumen extension | Excel-style name; same as VAR.S. (As a keyword, VAR declares a variable.) |
| VARA | Lumen extension | Excel-style name; same as VAR.S. |
| XOR | Lumen extension |  |

## Statements and keywords

These are part of the language rather than functions, and are supported: `VAR` / `RETURN`, `EVALUATE`, `DEFINE` with `MEASURE`, `VAR`, `TABLE`, `COLUMN` and `FUNCTION`, `ORDER BY`, `START AT`, the `IN` operator and table constructors `{ … }`. A query-scoped `DEFINE TABLE` can be evaluated and used as a table expression, but its columns cannot be referenced as `Table[Column]`; see [Known differences](../dax/known-differences-from-the-power-bi-engine.md).

## Autocomplete entries without an implementation

The DAX editor's autocomplete offers 87 functions that the engine does not implement: `ACCRINT`, `ACCRINTM`, `AMORDEGRC`, `AMORLINC`, `BETA.DIST`, `BETA.INV`, `CHISQ.DIST`, `CHISQ.DIST.RT`, `CHISQ.INV`, `CHISQ.INV.RT`, `CLOSINGBALANCEWEEK`, `COLUMNSTATISTICS`, `COMBINA`, `CONFIDENCE.NORM`, `CONFIDENCE.T`, `COUPDAYBS`, `COUPDAYS`, `COUPDAYSNC`, `COUPNCD`, `COUPNUM`, `COUPPCD`, `CUMIPMT`, `CUMPRINC`, `DATESWTD`, `DB`, `DDB`, `DISC`, `DOLLARDE`, `DOLLARFR`, `DURATION`, `EFFECT`, `ENDOFWEEK`, `EXPON.DIST`, `FV`, `INTRATE`, `IPMT`, `ISAFTER`, `ISPMT`, `LINEST`, `LINESTX`, `MDURATION`, `NEXTWEEK`, `NOMINAL`, `NORM.DIST`, `NORM.INV`, `NORM.S.DIST`, `NORM.S.INV`, `NPER`, `ODDFPRICE`, `ODDFYIELD`, `ODDLPRICE`, `ODDLYIELD`, `OPENINGBALANCEWEEK`, `PDURATION`, `PMT`, `POISSON.DIST`, `PPMT`, `PREVIOUSWEEK`, `PRICE`, `PRICEDISC`, `PRICEMAT`, `PV`, `RATE`, `RECEIVED`, `ROLLUPISSUBTOTAL`, `RRI`, `SLN`, `SQRTPI`, `STARTOFWEEK`, `SYD`, `T.DIST`, `T.DIST.2T`, `T.DIST.RT`, `T.INV`, `T.INV.2T`, `TBILLEQ`, `TBILLPRICE`, `TBILLYIELD`, `TOCSV`, `TOJSON`, `TOTALWTD`, `VDB`, `XIRR`, `XNPV`, `YIELD`, `YIELDDISC`, `YIELDMAT`. A formula that uses them fails when it is evaluated.
